software_used: LightGBM 4.6.0; NumPy 1.26.4; pandas 2.3.3; pymatgen 2025.10.7; exact dependencies in requirements.txt
hardware_used: Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-10600KF CPU @ 4.10GHz; CPU only, 4 threads
timing_scope: Final estimator fit plus 81-structure feature extraction and prediction; excludes development CV, training-feature extraction, installation and data download
model_description: Fixed L1 LightGBM, 600 trees, 196 base features plus 10 layer-geometry descriptors and validity flag; native NaN; no split_name input.
training_protocol: Single seed 0; final fit on 650 official train rows only. Recipe selected by development CV on 731 train+validation rows.
evaluation_provenance: One newly frozen candidate. Historical V7 audits previously examined this public test benchmark; globally blind test independence is not claimed.
package_license: Benchmark reproduction and evaluation only; submitted predictions, metadata and external wrapper may be redistributed under leaderboard terms.
